//telemetry: Optional key `telemetry` is not set here on purpose. When absent, span telemetry (scripts/skailr/emit-telemetry.mjs) is enabled iff a `.skailr/` dir exists at repo root. To force it, add a sibling key: "telemetry": { "enabled": true } (or false). See .claude/skills/emit-telemetry/SKILL.md and .claude/program/schemas/telemetry-event.schema.json. install.sh copies this file only if absent, so your choice survives upgrades.

hooks.command: node scripts/skailr/validate-channels.mjs --dir .claude/program/channels 2>/dev/null || true; node scripts/skailr/validate-channels.mjs --tmp 2>/dev/null || true
